status: 0.79.13 OPEN: common queue Present consumer integrated in Device runtime; boot/mode transition integration remains open
scope: Explicit internal registration binds the real common CPU shadow to its existing native display Use. Runtime consumes queue jobs and performs pitch-aware CE transfers. No automatic native takeover or visible-image claim.

facts.binding: One imported SYSTEM XRGB shadow reference survives creator close. Exact immutable buffer identity, geometry, bound native image and active Window gate empty-target uploads. The existing display Use protects native VRAM; no fabricated target queue reference or second conflicting device Use.
facts.copy: Common source_offset/span is decoded into x/y/width/height. One C6B5/C7B5 19-word 2D packet copies rows using distinct tight source/aligned target pitches, including full-width last rows. Full padded source/target spans are bounded; ordinary 17-word linear copies remain byte-identical.
facts.lifetime: Queue owns source access; confirmed whole-BO mappings are reused. Actual retained mapping, source identity, target Use, transfer geometry and encoded bytes gate submission. Fetch or data writes alone never complete a job: SYS-scope CE semaphore release does. Timeout or queued firmware fault reports device-lost and retains reachable source/target storage.
facts.scheduling: Serialized queue notification sets pending and wakes the existing pacing semaphore. Bounded Device steps take/map/copy/complete jobs. Pending frames allow an in-progress output query to drain. Retirement rejects live presentation channels. RC diagnosis correlates the real pitched target span and common fence.

validation.reference: 220-byte fixture compiled from six complete original C56F/C6B5/C7B5/type/DRF headers, independent of Zig. Existing transport group checks both class packets, GPFIFO lengths and invalid extents.
validation.device: Three cases in the existing actual Device group: two distinct rectangles including the last full-width row and output-query interleave; timeout without semaphore; RC fault queued together with a valid completion. Includes creator close, source mapping reuse, every modeled VRAM byte/padding, malformed rectangle, actual admission tampering and retained teardown.
validation.guest: No unchanged QEMU rerun; Kernel/Contract/SDK/common queues unchanged.
validation.limits: Targeted host/model proof only; no physical GPU, visible image, HDMI sound or mode adoption tested.

sources.fixture: Original C56F/C6B5/C7B5 class definitions and Nouveau DRF macros, no Zig encoder linked.
